doc: Every test of docs/PROOF-PLAN.md section 3. Read by tools/proof/prove.py. Placeholders in argv: {instances} {instances_sp} {host} {client} {i0} {inst_dir0} {outdir} {game_dir} and any key of params. A token that is a list is optional: it is dropped when a placeholder inside has no value. A required param with value null makes the test BLOCKED (set it in tools/proof/params.local.json). blocked_reason = a hand step or a missing piece that is not automated yet; prove.py never runs such a test. n = consecutive clean runs needed; one of them must be a fresh boot.

tests.title: actor port single-copy proof (36 checks)
tests.notes: exit 0 pass, 1 failed checks, 3 not wired. npc_ref is the Goodsprings powder ganger of scenarios/goodsprings_enemies.json and only a hint: when he is not loaded with 3D after the scenario jump, the script waits and then uses the nearest loaded character of the cell (tools/runner/npc_pick.py).

tests.title: actor port in a session: GetRestrained flips with ownership, ledger empties on leave
tests.notes: the first command (drivers/load_scenario.py) jumps both copies to the Goodsprings scenario: a booted copy sits in the main menu, so no NPC is loaded and coop.owner knows none (NOT READY). npc_ref is only a hint: when both copies do not know it, proof_actor_port_two_copy.py waits for and uses an NPC of the host's cell that they do (tools/runner/npc_pick.py). provisions exactly the actors lane (nvcoop.ini live.actors=1, dev.bots=1) because the wiring step expects 'actors' only (live_wiring_proof.py --expect: nothing is on that was not asked for); the other live.* keys must be absent

tests.title: save with a restrained NPC, single-player load, NPC is not frozen (ACLG cosave)
tests.notes: INGAME-TESTS step 1-2 item 6 scripted: the script saves with the NPC restrained, loads the save and reads GetRestrained and the ACLG cosave line of nvcoop.log The first command (drivers/load_scenario.py) loads the autosave and walks the player to the powder ganger (npc_ref), because a freshly booted copy has no save loaded and the NPC does not exist yet.

tests.notes: --weapon is left out: the weapon steps print SKIP. exit 0 no FAIL, 1 FAIL, 3 anim.npc missing or no loaded NPC. npc_ref is only a hint (the nearest loaded character is used when he is not loaded) and is turned into a runtime id: anim.npc.do parses the whole ref as hex. tests.title: fight under the bad_wifi chaos profile, seed 7
tests.notes: tools/chaos/chaos_pair.py starts the seeded relay (docs/tools/T5-chaos.md) in front of the host's real port, makes the client leave and join through it (coop.leave, coop.join), runs the fight with bad_wifi seed 7 applied over the relay's RPC info file, then puts the client back on the host's port. allow_repairs: an impaired link repairs digests on purpose; the runner has its own repairs-per-minute budget.

tests.title: installer, uninstaller, packager and launcher tests on a fake game folder
Check.cmd, Install.cmd, Uninstall.cmd on a clean game copy
tests.notes: Game-free: builds a synthetic release zip, unzips it, and runs its Check.cmd, Install.cmd and Uninstall.cmd with cmd.exe on a fake New Vegas folder (FNV_GAME_DIR, FNV_DOCUMENTS_DIR and an isolation shim keep it off this PC's real install and processes). Covers docs/INGAME-TESTS.md step 10 items 1 and 5.

tests.title: launcher host and join over loopback, with and without chaos (headless)
tests.notes: Game-free: the launcher's own start_session / TestListener / probe on 127.0.0.1 with two fake game folders, then again through the seeded chaos relay (bad_wifi seed 7) including a one-way partition. The real two-PC run stays in lan_two_pc.

tests.title: split-screen smoke playbook with synthetic pads (2 players, movement)
tests.notes: alone: the split-screen launcher refuses while any other FalloutNV.exe runs, so prove.py stops its own copies first and runs nothing beside it; launches: 2 makes the owner-PC guard and the RAM rule count the two copies the driver starts (instances 40.., ../fnv-instances-split). The driver takes a game slot, runs launch.py up --dev-inject, the smoke playbook, and launch.py down in a finally.

tests.title: build and test from the exported public tree
tests.notes: Exports the public tree to a temp folder outside the checkout (never pushes), requires SCAN CLEAN and a second scan of its own, runs test_all.py --quick inside the export, then builds plugin/all there (xNVSE sources from third_party/NVSE, or --nvse; exit 3 = BLOCKED when absent). Takes minutes and a lot of CPU: queue it when the owner is away.
